name: Mien ngan
summary: Miến ngan is goose glass noodles. Báo Nghệ An names it on đường Hồ Sỹ Dương at night and, on 28 April 2023, among the fixed kitchens on Đào Tấn. A method was not printed.
origin: Vinh. Two Báo Nghệ An reports name the bowl, on two streets.
howToEat: Order it at night on either street. Neither report says what else is in the bowl. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Đường Hồ Sỹ Dương, closing hour Check on arrival. Đường Đào Tấn, fixed kitchens allowed 24 hours on the 27 April 2023 account. A 2026 night list was not opened.
